Can you confirm whether Redwood has an active incident? We need an ETA for mitigation and whether you can steer traffic away from the affected AZ while you investigate — this is affecting our production SLA.

- Sara

On Tue, Mar 20, 2028 at 08:25, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sara — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We see the uptick from our side as well; I’m escalating to Eng & Infra and will keep you updated every 30 minutes until resolved.

We’ve pulled service-side metrics and a few things look suspicious: KV cache miss rate in us-west-2a jumped 12x at 07:58, and a subset of inference hosts started returning 502/503 then 500. No deployment recorded in the window.

Preliminary hypothesis: cache tier (local KV shards) in us-west-2a is saturating, causing downstream request queueing and overload on inference workers which then trips application-level error surfaces.

Mitigation plan (immediate):
1) Initiate cross-AZ routing: mark us-west-2a as degraded in the smart-router for Novus routes only (steer to us-west-2b and us-west-1 pools).
2) Reduce request concurrency for affected model variants (temp limit to 8 concurrent tokens) to lower tail latency.
3) Clear stale KV shards for Novus-specific prefixes (snapshot attached).

I’m executing step 1 now (expected ~3–4 min for global route propagation). I’ll post changes and the tracer when done.

-marcus
Senior SWE, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

Sara — final update for this thread (stabilization):
- What we did: targeted route-steer for Novus traffic off us-west-2a to us-west-2b and us-west-1; applied temp concurrency throttles; cleared a small set of stale KV shard entries that were over-indexed for Novus prefixes.
- Outcome: error rate returned to baseline (~<0.5%) at 11:18 PDT, throughput restored to ~95% of normal by 11:30 PDT.
- Next steps: Marcus/Eng will open a follow-up RFC to harden shard eviction logic and add early alarms for asymmetric KV miss growth. We will provide a full RCA and timeline for a permanent mitigation within 72 hours.
- Compensation: We acknowledge SLA impact and will propose a pro-rated credit for the affected window; Lauren will coordinate with Finance.

We appreciate the quick patience from your ops team. If Novus would like a post-incident call (30 min) to walk through technical details and the mitigation plan, we can schedule for tomorrow.

Best,
Mina Haddad
